marta: Quick run results for 70B bringup (eval-v2) across eu-west1 (H100) and asia-east1 (A100). Raw CSV below.

```csv
region,gpu,quant,p50_ms,p95_ms,tokens_sec
eu-west1,H100,q4f16,120,420,820
asia-east1,A100,q4f16,160,620,640
eu-west1,H100,q2_k,140,520,900
asia-east1,A100,q2_k,190,740,700
```

devon: Oof, APAC A100 p95 is rough for q4f16. What's the concurrency and seq len on this run?

marta: Concurrency=6 (per-GPU), batch_size=auto, median seq_len=1024, 95th seq ~1800.

sherif: Recommendation: target concurrency=8 on H100 for q4f16, but cap to 4 on A100 in asia until we enable tiled/fused kernels. APAC sees longer seq tails so packing hurts.

len: For Dedicated autoscale headroom I'd start with +30% spare slots and a warmup_fraction=0.2. Slotting (pack-first) saves cost but needs more warmup budget vs pinning.

anna-qa: Any quality regressions with q2_k vs q4f16? Earlier runs showed a slight diff.

marta: Initial eval on 500 prompts showed small LM score drift (delta ~0.5%), but conversational coherence tests flagged a subset (~0.8 BLEU drop) for q2_k. Need full 3k prompt eval.

devon: I'll add a shot-noise poisson burst sim with tail spikes (lambda base, +300% for 60s) and measure p99/P95 from the sim. Also test route-fallbacks.

infra-bot: Canary deploy for 70B-q4f16 scheduled at <https://deploys/redwood/1234> in 1h :rocket:

sherif: Also add kernel fallback rule: if per-GPU p95 > 600ms for 2 consecutive minutes route new requests to tiled-attn variant or smaller 30B model.

devon: Ack. Will update runtime policy and add the fallback config. Sim will include pack vs pin scenarios.

marta: Action items: 1) run 3k evals for q2_k vs q4f16 (marta), 2) run poisson burst sims with H100/A100 configs and concurrency knobs (devon), 3) update capacity sim +30% warm slots and produce GPU count ask (len+devon), 4) add kernel fallback policy to canary (sherif).

marta: If sims confirm, ask for Dedicated capacity: eu-west1: 12 H100 GPUs (70B pool, concurrency 8 target), asia-east1: 16 A100 GPUs (concurrency 4 target + warm pool), reserve for 25% warmup + burst headroom.

len: Sounds reasonable. We'll draft the capacity request and include cost delta for +25% warm/reserved vs on-demand autoscale.

marta: Thanks all :thumbsup:. I'll post updated numbers in this thread after sims finish (~4h).
